test_title: PYST 67: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Convert the sentence provided below from its passive voice structure to an active voice structure: 

The law is supposed to be enforced strictly in sensitive areas.

options.text: The law enforces itself strictly in sensitive areas.
It is supposed that someone strictly enforced the law.
Authorities are supposed to enforce the law strictly in sensitive areas.
Strict enforcement of law is supposed in sensitive regions.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Active voice structure: The subject performing the action becomes the main subject of the sentence. In passive sentences where the doer is implied (not explicitly stated with "by"), a logical subject must be supplied.
 
• In the passive voice, the sentence is: "The law is supposed to be enforced strictly in sensitive areas."
 
• To convert to active voice: First, identify the implied doer of the action. Who enforces the law? Usually, it is the "Authorities" or "police." Place this logical doer at the beginning as the new subject.
 
• Change the passive infinitive phrase "to be enforced" to its active counterpart "to enforce."
 
• Place the original passive subject "the law" after the verb to serve as the new object, and keep the modifiers ("strictly in sensitive areas") intact.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Authorities are supposed to enforce the law strictly in sensitive areas."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The law enforces itself strictly in sensitive areas." – Incorrect meaning (laws cannot enforce themselves; they require an external agent).
 
• **Option 2: **"It is supposed that someone strictly enforced the law." – Incorrect tense (uses the past tense "enforced" instead of the present).
 
• **Option 4: **"Strict enforcement of law is supposed in sensitive regions." – Incorrect structure (it uses a noun phrase instead of converting the verb to an active form, and still remains passive in meaning).
